constraints: Keep the base image, requires-python, CI matrices, and deployment runtimes on one supported Python release.
Confirm binary wheels and dependencies support the target Python release; rebuild any virtual environment or wheel cache inside the image.

steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.
steps.title: Update the base image

steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.
steps.title: Align other image references

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container runs the intended Python version.

rule.replacement: A python image on a later supported release line
rule.summary: Python 3.11 is scheduled to stop receiving security fixes from the Python core team on 2027-10-31, so images tagged with it will then be built on an unsupported runtime.
rule.title: Python image release line 3.11 reaches end-of-life on 2027-10-31
